entities.summary: Norris Gene Cole II is an American professional basketball player for the Osos de Manatí of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN). A 6-foot-2 point guard, he is a two-time NBA champion, winning back-to-back titles in 2012 and 2013 with the Miami Heat in his first and second years in the NBA. In his seven NBA seasons, Cole made the playoffs all but once (2016).
